        LD      A,1+LAB1*2
        DB      1,LAB1,"X",2,#3,%101
        DW      LAB1+2,3
LAB3
;COMMENT  TWO  SPACES
;INDENTED COMMENT
        LD      (IX+5),A
        LD      A,(IX-LAB1)
        JP      (HL)
        EX      AF,AF'
        LD      HL,"AB"
        CP      " "
        INCLUDE PARTS
        DS      10,"AB"
        PUSH    AF,BC
        LD      A,5             ;C1
LAB4    NOP                     ;C2
        LD      A,LAB1
        LD      A,1,B,2
        LD      A,LAB1+#10
        LD      DE,LAB1-$
        DB      #AB,LAB1
        JR      C,LAB1
        RET     C
        LD      A,C
LAB5    LD      HL,LAB4
        DW      LAB1,LAB2
